name: standings
title: NBA standings
description: An NBA standings card for json-render chats: one conference's regular-season table with each team's place, logo, wins, losses, win percentage, games behind, conference, home, away and last-ten records, and streak, on Fluid Functionalism's Table, with its API route in front of ESPN's public standings.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   StandingsCard: standingsCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: StandingsCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveStandingsCard conference={props.conference || undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     StandingsCard: standingsLookup

Standings load from /api/standings (installed at app/api/standings/route.ts), backed by ESPN's public site API. No API key needed.
